text: Ɓe wi'i: Hara oo gorko fefindor fenaande e hoore Alla aaƴagol ummital men ɓaawo maayde? Kaa hara ko feetere woni mo defude e wiide ɗum? Oo'oo, wanaa no ɓe sikkiri non ! Si ko woni, ɓe gomɗinaaɓe ɓen laakara, ɓe wonoyay e lepte tiiɗuɗe Ñalnde Darngal, ɓe wonii e majjere woɗɗundi goonga ka aduna ɗoo.
